parts.name: Disclosure
parts.description: Radix collapsible root with controlled or uncontrolled open state. Native div attributes are forwarded.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when opening or closing is requested.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable disclosure trigger interactions.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through one child element instead of the default element. The child must forward its ref and accept the supplied props.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: DisclosureTrigger
parts.description: A native button in a semantic heading. The component owns its trigger ID and solid triangle; asChild is not supported.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Semantic heading level wrapping the trigger button.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: DisclosureContent
parts.description: A labelled collapsible region. Native attributes and ref apply to the outer panel, which contains a spacing wrapper.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the Radix content mounted for externally managed visibility or animation. The consumer must manage its closed presentation.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
